sloka: ताम् अदुह्ख उचिताम् द्Rष्ट्वा पतिताम् कदलीम् इव ।रामः तु उत्थापयाम् आस मातरम् गत चेतसम् ॥२-२०-३३॥
transliteration: tām aduhkha ucitām dRṣṭvā patitām kadalīm iva ।rāmaḥ tu utthāpayām āsa mātaram gata cetasam ॥2-20-33॥

translations.english: Seeing his mother who had done nothing to deserve (this) suffering and who had fallen down like a plantain tree, deprived of her senses, Rama raised her up (from the ground).
